maddeler.e:
ينقلب (form VII)
# يَنْقَلِبُ (yanqalibu) /jan.qa.li.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْقَلَبَ (inqalaba)
# يُنْقَلَبُ (yunqalabu) /jun.qa.la.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْقَلَبَ (inqalaba)
# يَنْقَلِبَ (yanqaliba) /jan.qa.li.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَلَبَ (inqalaba)
# يُنْ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
